description: A primary government report plus two independently researched analyses of the same policy domain. Acceptance test: these count as MORE THAN one stream (exactly 3). No shared URLs, independence keys, wire origin, upstream identifiers, citations, or copied language may merge them.

sources.title: Department releases 2026 grid storage procurement study
sources.lead: The Department of Energy today published its annual grid storage procurement study covering bid volumes, awarded capacity, and price curves for fiscal year 2026.

sources.title: Independent benchmarking reveals widening spreads in regional power auctions
sources.lead: Our analysts collected bid-level data from twelve regional auctions and found that clearing price spreads widened materially during the second quarter of 2026.

sources.title: Survey of interconnection queues shows developers resequencing projects
sources.lead: Reporters interviewed forty project developers and reviewed queue filings, documenting how battery projects are being resequenced ahead of thermal retirements.
